title: PaginatedResponse
description: Used to wrap results for a paginated response, containing information on how to retrieve further pages and, if  available, the total number of results.

nextPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page. The value of this token is passed into the field pageToken.  This value can be null if there is no next page.

prevPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the previous page. The value of this token is passed into the field pageToken.  This value can be null of there is no previous page.

totalSize.description: The number of resource entries being returned from the result set.  This can be omitted if the API endpoint does not have total size information.

results.description: The result set from a collection API call.
